nolviko.captcha.title: CAPTCHA
nolviko.captcha.reauth: Confirm your password first; changing these settings needs a confirmation from the last 15 minutes.
nolviko.captcha.error_site_key: Paste the site key from the service (letters, numbers, - and _).
nolviko.captcha.error_secret: Paste the secret key (8-200 characters, no spaces).
nolviko.captcha.error_failed: The settings could not be saved. Try again.
nolviko.captcha.saved: Saved. Open the registration page in a private window to try it.
nolviko.captcha.removed: Removed. Registration uses the built-in challenge again.
nolviko.captcha.status_on_help: The registration form shows the CAPTCHA.
nolviko.captcha.status_off_help: The built-in challenge (Admin > Registration) protects registration until a service is set up here.
nolviko.captcha.privacy: An outside CAPTCHA sends the visitor's address and browser data to that service. Cloudflare Turnstile collects the least and shows no puzzles; reCAPTCHA sets Google cookies. Mention the service in your privacy policy.
nolviko.captcha.step_choose: Choose a service below. Cloudflare Turnstile is free and usually invisible to people.
nolviko.captcha.step_keys: Create a site for your forum's address and copy the site key and the secret key:
nolviko.captcha.step_test: Save, then open the registration page in a private window. Each service has test keys that always pass, for trying it on a local site.
nolviko.captcha.secret_kept: Saved; leave empty to keep it
nolviko.captcha.mode_replace: Use the CAPTCHA instead of the built-in challenge
nolviko.captcha.threshold_help: 0.1 to 0.9; forms below this score are refused (0.5 is Google's suggestion).
